meta.title: neoCRM · The CRM for field teams, secure and accessible
meta.description: neoCRM is a CRM for field teams under your own brand: data separated per client, permissions by role and territory, an access log and an interface built for everyone.

titles.default: The CRM for your field team, secure and accessible
titles.clinicas: The CRM for clinics and healthcare networks, secure and accessible
titles.distribucion: The CRM for distributors and laboratories, secure and accessible
titles.equipos: The CRM for sales teams, secure and accessible

hero.body: Visits, accounts and follow-up in one place, under your brand and in your language. Each client's data is kept separate, each person sees only what they should, and every access is logged.

notes.all: The usual order of the page.
notes.direccion: Order for management: who it is for and how it gets started come first.
notes.it: Order for IT and security: security, privacy and accessibility come first.
notes.operaciones: Order for operations: the product and the team's day-to-day come first.

who.title: Who it is for
who.lead: Small and mid-sized companies with people who work away from the office and need to know who they saw, what was said and what comes next.

clinicas.title: Clinics and healthcare networks
clinicas.body: Follow-up of professionals and centres, with a record of who views health data and permissions fitted to each job.

distribucion.title: Distributors and laboratories
distribucion.body: Reps with their territory, their calendar and a form after each visit; managers who see their team.

equipos.title: Sales teams
equipos.body: Accounts, contacts and next steps in order, without spreadsheets each person keeps their own way.

product.title: What it does
product.lead: What a field team uses every day, designed for the phone first.

items.title: Accounts and contacts
items.body: Organisations and people on one record, with their visit history.

items.title: Visits with their report
items.body: A short form after each visit, so what was agreed does not depend on memory.

items.title: Territories and calendar
items.body: Each person works their area and keeps their visits in a calendar.

items.title: Team view
items.body: Whoever leads sees the team's activity; whoever visits sees their own.

items.title: On the phone, like an app
items.body: It opens in the browser and can be installed on the home screen, with no app store involved.

brand.title: Under your brand and in your language
brand.lead: Your team opens its own tool, not a vendor's.

items.title: Your name, logo and colours
items.body: The brand is configured per client, with no custom development.

items.title: Spanish, English and Polish
items.body: Each person uses the app in their language.

items.title: Your words
items.body: Menu and field names can be adapted to how you speak inside the company.

security.title: Security
security.lead: Measures that are in the product today. What we do not have yet is listed further down, without dates.

items.title: Data separated per client
items.body: Each company has its own database schema; it shares no tables with others.

items.title: Permissions by role and territory
items.body: Six roles, from administration to rep, also limited by area. Each person sees only what they need.

items.title: Access log
items.body: Who did what, and who viewed health data, is written down.

items.title: Passwords and sessions
items.body: Passwords are stored hashed with bcrypt and sessions use short-lived credentials that are renewed.

items.title: Service protection
items.body: Attempt limits, security headers and an allow-list of origins on the API.

items.title: Backups
items.body: Every night, encrypted, with a check that they can be restored.

items.title: Continuous code review
items.body: Automatic security analysis and secret scanning on every change; dependencies updated weekly.

items.title: Keys locked away
items.body: Service credentials live in a managed secret store, never in the code or the browser.

access.title: Accessibility
access.lead: A work tool has to serve the whole team. This is what the interface already does.

items.title: Text with enough contrast
items.body: Text and button colours are chosen to read well, in the dark theme too.

items.title: Buttons that fit a finger
items.body: Touch controls measure at least 44 pixels.

items.title: Less motion if you ask
items.body: The app respects the device setting that reduces animations.

items.title: Errors that are announced
items.body: Form errors are also communicated to screen readers.

items.title: Everything by keyboard
items.body: Dialogs open, can be walked through and close without a mouse.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.lead: Designed with the GDPR in mind. Here we prefer to be exact.

items.title: Where the data is
items.body: Today the service and the database are hosted in the United States, with cloud providers. If you need another region, see "What we are working on".

items.title: Consent on record
items.body: Each person's consent is stored with its date.

items.title: Who has seen what
items.body: The access log lets you answer when someone asks who viewed their data.

items.title: This page does not follow you
items.body: It uses no advertising or analytics cookies. A personal link only carries a name in the address; it is not stored or sent.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.lead: For a small company, starting should not be a project.

items.title: 1. Demo
items.body: We show you the product with a case close to yours.

items.title: 2. Your space
items.body: We create your space with brand, language, roles and territories.

items.title: 3. Your team
items.body: You add your people and they start logging visits from the phone.

items.title: 4. Adjustments
items.body: We review the first weeks together and adapt wording and permissions.

roadmap.title: What we are working on
roadmap.lead: We do not have these yet. We would rather say so here than promise them on the cover. We give no dates.

items.title: WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility · in progress
items.body: Automated tests on every change and a public accessibility statement.

items.title: ISO 27001 · in progress
items.body: We have started the internal gap analysis. There is no certification or external audit yet.

items.title: Two-step verification · planned
items.body: A second factor at sign-in.

items.title: Hosting in the European Union · planned
items.body: An option to keep the service and the data in a European region.

faq.title: Frequent questions
faq.lead: What people usually ask us before a demo.

items.title: Does it suit a small company?
items.body: Yes. It is made for teams of a few people who need order without setting up an IT department.

items.title: Is there anything to install?
items.body: No. It runs in the browser on phone and computer, and can be added to the home screen.

items.title: Can we use our brand?
items.body: Yes: name, logo, colours and language are configured per client.

items.title: Do you hold external security seals?
items.body: Not yet. What is under way appears in "What we are working on"; what already works, in "Security".

items.title: How much does it cost?
items.body: It depends on the number of people and the configuration. We send a proposal after the demo.

contact.title: Request a demo
contact.body: Half an hour, with a case close to yours and time for security questions.
